body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2013') -- i-KAIST (President Kim, Sung-jin, www.i-kaist.com) unveiled the world's first 65" capacitive touch screen at '2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after 'CES 2013') held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11'

The size formation of this product is flexible with its one-chip on glass. it is 65" capacitive touch screen that runs with controller and low-spec PC. It also supports quick speed of response ( max 1ms/ min 7ms) and unlimited multi touch system (max 255 pt/ min 10 pt)

Over 30" capacitive touch screen used to uncontrollable due to its noise occurrence and filtering process of display. The server PC was in need to solve this problem, but it has disadvantages of high price ( over 1oo million dollar) and complicated wiring system.
But small enterprise of South Korea made this unpopular technology into success with its diffusion type.

This relevant touchscreen has 23/27/46/55/65/82" that controller supports maximum of 100" screen. It is expected for MS Touch model 'All-In-One' PC industry, Digital Information Display(DID), kiosk, electronic black board and surface to constribute to computer table industry's popularization.

i-KAIST also plans to unveil not only touch screen but also smart conference software program 'BIZBOX' . Once you touch your 5 fingers on the screen, each mini icons are displayed to do word processing, writing on the blackboard, etc at the same time with people.
In addition, it is all connected to each PC tablet pad that it automatically sends your photos/videos/pictures once you shake your tablets in front of touch screen.

Lee, Chang-wook , department head of i-KAIST said " these touch screens will be available on your dinning table, desk, tea table etc in near future. And we are sure that our touch screen will be popularized and contribute to the development of industry with affordable price.
